column1: # Claude's two passes (QUALITY.md end) for Imagination Nights (English, Mindset door). The 'pastor' column is the safety and ethics read for this door (no faith words or links, no outcome or health promises, no controlling other people, real help pointed to); the cultural column is the listener read.

column3: Teachings in our own words only (living in the end, the drowsy state, revision, a friend's congratulations); no book quoted and the teacher is never named, so no affiliation line is needed; every teaching says plainly it is imagination and feeling, not a promise, and that the real daytime steps still matter ('not a guarantee' reworded so no promise word appears). The love night forbids picturing another person changing their mind and tells anyone in a frightening relationship to reach out for help; revision keeps apologies owed as real; work night pictures bills paid on time, not riches. No God's Word words, journeys or scripture (scripture_woven false).
column5: Warm, plain English for a tired woman at 11 PM; ordinary scenes (porch light, mug, key in the lock, card and pen) with no luxury or wealth fantasy; moving house and long job searches named gently; two settles with a body scan and two closes so nights vary; pacing by silence (18.9-20.4 min).
